summary.headline: Dev IT Q4 FY26 consolidated total income rose 8.1% YoY to INR56 crore, EBITDA up 68.5% to INR5.04 crore at 8.99% margin; FY26 income INR193.5 crore.
summary.overview: Management reported Q4 FY26 consolidated total income of about INR56 crore (+8.1% YoY), EBITDA of INR5.04 crore (+68.5%) and a margin of 8.99% (+322 bps), with net profit of about INR8.96 crore versus INR1.13 crore a year earlier. FY26 total income was about INR193.5 crore, at the lower end of the INR190-200 crore guidance range, and management flagged that FY26 EBITDA margin fell sharply versus FY25, which included about INR13 crore of exceptional income. Strategic changes in the year included XDuce Infotech acquiring about 25% of the company from promoters, a US-acquired Microsoft/AI alignment, and transfer of Talligence and ByteSIGNER product businesses to Technosys for about INR11.9 crore cash.

segments.name: India market
segments.commentary: Contributed 67% of FY26 revenue; management prioritised India government and corporate wins, with empanelment at NIXI, Gujarat, Rajasthan and Chandigarh governments, though margins are lower.

segments.name: Export / international
segments.commentary: Export revenue about INR45 crore in FY26 (INR35 crore prior year); management says the export focus is now on North America via XDuce and UCI integration.

segments.name: Cloud
segments.commentary: Cloud revenue about INR25 crore in FY26; cybersecurity revenue estimated at INR5-8 crore.

segments.name: Managed IT services
segments.commentary: About 27% of total revenue; traditional manpower-based work described as a very small share.

segments.name: Talligence and ByteSIGNER (products)
segments.commentary: Product businesses transferred to Technosys Pvt Ltd for about INR11.9 crore cash; management says this lets DEV IT focus on services and reduces product-related cash burn and EBITDA drag.

segments.name: GA (Dev Consulting / Dhyey) and Microsoft Dynamics
segments.commentary: GA focused on US and Canada export clients; a UCI New York shareholding agreement signed last month for 25% stake, with more than USD3 million of US Microsoft Dynamics business expected.

guidance_outlook: FY27 total income expected around INR200 crore, per management.
FY28 growth expected at 15-20% over FY27.

XDuce business expected at USD1-2 million in FY27 (current year), rising to USD3-5 million from FY28 per the call, growing 15-20% YoY thereafter; revenue split 80:20 in DEV IT's favour on front-ended non-India work.
Management expects EBITDA to grow as product businesses are moved out, but gave no numeric margin target.
Management said DEV IT becomes XDuce worldwide global delivery centre; integration with XDuce, UCI and GA is the current focus.
capex_capacity: Headcount about 1,000-1,100 people, with more hiring expected in the current year.
Skill development investment ran longer than planned (originally to end June/July 2025); still ongoing.
Scaleax JV (four partners) to provide GCC-as-a-service, focused on GIFT City, Gandhinagar.
Physical presence expanding in North America, UK and Australia/New Zealand; no capex figure given.
demand_pricing: Average deal size about USD80,000-100,000 with at least a 2-year contract term; historic trend not available on the call.
Around 600-700 live customers, mainly SMB; 35-40 strategic customers added in FY26; repeat revenue 27-30%.

Management cited Microsoft solutions partner designations (6 competencies, said to be held by about 5% of the North American Microsoft partner ecosystem) and CMMI Level 5 as win drivers; one Texas deal of USD60-70k was won on these.
Pricing power described qualitatively as supported by lean delivery processes and alliances; no billing rate data given.
Blockchain export business had not picked up in FY26 due to market conditions.

qa_highlights.question: What strategic benefits has the XDuce partnership brought, and what revenue is expected?
qa_highlights.answer: XDuce brings US/UK on-site presence and enterprise BFSI, healthcare and government clients; expected USD1-2 million business in the current year, USD3-5 million from FY27, growing 15-20% YoY; work split 80% DEV IT / 20% XDuce.

qa_highlights.question: What is holding revenue growth back (FY26 growth about 5%)?
qa_highlights.answer: Management prioritised India orders with better strategic fit, profitability and cash flow, and paused export push during geopolitical uncertainty; targets FY27 income of about INR200 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Why did FY26 EBITDA margin decline?
qa_highlights.answer: Lower exceptional income (about INR13 crore in FY25 vs about INR4 crore in FY26), a lower-margin India mix, bandwidth diverted to the XDuce/UCI alliance, and people investment in ABCD ahead of revenue, with some work outsourced at lower margin.

qa_highlights.question: Why transfer Talligence and ByteSIGNER to Technosys?
qa_highlights.answer: Strategic partners want to align with the product, not the company; products need heavy investment in development and marketing and consume cash, weighing on DEV IT's EBITDA; the transfer may also help attract investors to Talligence.

qa_highlights.question: What do the Microsoft SPD designations add?
qa_highlights.answer: Not quantified; cited a Texas deal, and high-value business in final talks in Canada and UK attributed to the designations.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY26 revenue mix and new customer count?
qa_highlights.answer: India 67% of revenue; repeat customers 27-30%; no exact count of new customers, though 35-40 strategic customers were added.

risks_watch: FY27 INR200 crore income target implies roughly 3.4% growth on FY26 INR193.5 crore; the earlier FY26 INR190-200 crore guidance was only partly met and the company was not on track in FY26 revenue growth.
Order book of INR50-60 crore is modest relative to the INR200 crore target; watch conversion.
Integration risk across XDuce, UCI and GA, which management said delayed the alliance by 4-5 months.
Margin recovery depends on lower-margin India mix and outsourcing; watch Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin versus 8.99% in Q4.
Talligence transfer and any strategic investment talks; monitor the INR11.9 crore consideration and the Technosys structure.
Some FY26 figures in the transcript are garbled (EBITDA and margin wording); verify against the filed results before relying on them.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on strategic partnerships and the North America push, but cautious and somewhat defensive on FY26 profitability, which management attributed to exceptional income, mix and alliance-related delays. Several answers were vague on quantification (new customer counts, SPD value, pricing power), and the call contained many numerical inconsistencies.
